header.title: For My Beloved, Adored, and Plushy-like Munchkin,
header.subtitle: I don't care how many obstacles come in the way, you don't have a way out. If you think we're losing the spark, I'll bring a taser.

introLetter:
Dear Ishika, 

I started working on this around 17th July. I had a dream about us and our future. What we were like, where we were living, and all the works. The exact snippet of our future I saw was us sitting on our porch in the rain. I got us the wine, while you played a mixtape I made for you. And I haven't been able to stop thinking about it since then. And I haven't stopped thinking about you and us since then. It feels as if there were magnets in my bones for the iron in your blood. 

One day we'll make that dream a reality, but till then let this "mixtape" keep you company. 

Yours Truly, 

 "Chumkins"

songs.title: Sunshine & Butterflies - lilypichu
songs.letter:
it all started when we first matched. all those nights of talking on Instagram. getting to know that we found each other in a very Chinese time of our life. getting to know we share a lot of the same opinions and stances. figuring out you're not a call person. still talking to you on call for 6 hours the first time. realizing this will be hell cause i am in love with your voice. and finally realizing i would put up with anything and everything if it meant being close to you. 

then it was the excitement of when college ended. every step was a step closer to you. packing my bag, all i could think was "will she like this shirt?" the flight home, the constant texting, the pure unbridled excitement in the air. i reached home. there were literally less than 12 hours before i finally met you. but it felt like an eternity. it was too much still. from sneaking out with my sister's help, to pushing the bike all the way outside the building compound, all the way to the point i was outside the campus gate waiting for you. 

you were everything i had hoped to find in a person. you were what i had been looking for in each person before you. and i hope you're all i look forward to from now on.

songs.title: Her - JVKE
songs.letter:
i remember the exact moment I met you. it was at 4:22am on 16th May. suddenly i stopped judging all the shitty romcoms I'd ever seen. suddenly all the songs about that "realization" on the first meet started making sense. you were the most ethereal being there ever was, and ever will be. you were it. you were the moment. that first hug happened, and i could understand why people fall for religious propaganda willingly. but you were religion perfected. 

you were exactly how you were online. your bubbly personality. your witty humor. your adorable gremlin like behavior. and your eyes. oh your eyes. i could stare into your eyes for eternity. the way you couldn't stand still while talking, and the immense excitement you had retelling me stories. it was infectious. and that was the moment i knew.

songs.title: Glue Song - Beabadoobee
songs.letter:
then came the best parts. the next 3 weeks or so were pure bliss (excluding the time i went to Hyderabad). every day was a new chance at getting to meet you. every day was a new chance to getting to know you. and every day was a new chance to kiss you once more. 

every date was supposed to be me taking you out. but somehow every date ended up with us laying in bed, cuddling for hours, just talking. and i couldn't ask for anything more. having you lay in my arms, being able to finally hold you, it felt like a dream. even though it had been only two months of waiting, it felt like i had gotten what i needed after years. 

ps: i have been trying to write this part for days, but no words feel good enough. i doubt such words exist, because none of them would do those moments justice.

songs.title: Lover, You Should've Come Over - Jeff Buckley
songs.letter:
i remember the night before you left, panicking because my mom didn't allow me to leave the house so late. i thought i'd have to settle for not meeting you one last time. maybe a goodbye doesn't have to be so perfect. but you, my glorious queen. despite having had such a long day, you decided to wake up early. just for me. somehow out of all the things you've done, that made me feel so appreciated. of COURSE you were so nonchalant about it. "yea i'll wake up, so what". 

i couldn't sleep that day. i think i played this song over and over and over and over. half of me was happy just being able to see you again, the other half dreaded it. i almost didn't come. i remember standing at the main door, helmet in hand, contemplating if i should really even leave. what if i can't let go? then i saw your message pop up, and all these thoughts just vanished. vanished so hard I FORGOT TO BRING MY PAN CARD. 

i finally reached your college at 7am. you looked so sleepy, i could cry. all i wanted to do was hold you in my arms. it wouldn't have even mattered if you had just slept. i wanted to take in every single moment. how you breathe, how you lay your arms across me, how your eyes express themselves so well. i memorized the edges of your smiles, and the beat frequencies of your laughter. in that moment, i felt i could recreate you from memory. and in that moment, you felt infinite. 

leaving you was one of the hardest things I've done, but simultaneously one of the easiest things too. it felt so obvious that we'll meet again. no matter where you go, i knew i would follow you. the entire ride home i could feel your lips on mine. and i knew despite not having you besides me, i had more than enough of you with me. 

not many get the chance to say goodbye, and i got almost half a day. 

(idk why this sounds like you died, but it really was that serious to me. sorry :p)
